disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation in obtaining or attempting to obtain a license or renewal
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any act or acts of fraud, deceit or misrepresentation in obtaining or attempting to obtain a license or the renewal thereof

disciplinary_grounds.description: Chronic or persistent use of intoxicants, drugs, or narcotics to the extent that it impairs ability to practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is a chronic or persistent user of intoxicants, drugs or narcotics to the extent that the same impairs his ability to practice optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of criminal provisions of this Article or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of any of the criminal provisions of this Article or has entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any charge or charges arising therefrom

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of or entered a plea to a felony charge or a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any felony charge or to any misdemeanor charge involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Convicted of or entered a plea to a violation of any state or federal narcotic or barbiturate law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been convicted of or entered a plea of guilty or nolo contendere to any charge of violation of any State or federal narcotic or barbiturate law

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in any act or practice violating the Article or Board rules, or aided others in violation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in any act or practice violative of any of the provisions of this Article or violative of any of the rules and regulations promulgated and adopted by the Board, or has aided, abetted or assisted any other person or entity in the violation of the same

disciplinary_grounds.description: Unable to practice with reasonable skill and safety due to substance abuse, physical or mental illness, or limiting condition
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is unable to practice optometry with reasonable skill and safety by reason of abuse of alcohol, drugs, chemicals, or any other type of substance, or by reason of any physical or mental illness, abnormality, or other limiting condition

disciplinary_grounds.description: Permitted use of name, diploma, or license by another for illegal practice or fraudulent licensing
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has permitted the use of his name, diploma or license by another person either in the illegal practice of optometry or in attempting to fraudulently obtain a license to practice optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaged in immoral conduct that discredits the optometry profession
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has engaged in such immoral conduct as to discredit the optometry profession

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtained or collected or attempted to obtain or collect any fee through fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has obtained or collected or attempted to obtain or collect any fee through fraud, misrepresentation, or deceit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Negligent in the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has been negligent in the practice of optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Employed an unlicensed person to perform acts that may only be performed by a licensed optometrist
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has employed a person not licensed in this State to do or perform any act of service, or has aided, abetted or assisted any such unlicensed person to do or perform any act or service which under this Article can lawfully be done or performed only by an optometrist licensed in this State

disciplinary_grounds.description: Incompetent in the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Is incompetent in the practice of optometry

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practiced fraud, deceit, or misrepresentation upon the public or individuals to acquire or retain patients, including false advertising
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Has practiced any fraud, deceit or misrepresentation upon the public or upon any individual in an effort to acquire or retain any patient or patients, including false or misleading advertising

disciplinary_grounds.description: Made fraudulent or misleading statements pertaining to skill, knowledge, or method of treatment

definition_quote.value: The examination of the human eye by any method, other than surgery, to diagnose, to treat, or to refer for consultation or treatment any abnormal condition of the human eye and its adnexa; or the employment of instruments, devices, pharmaceutical agents and procedures, other than surgery, intended for the purposes of investigating, examining, treating, diagnosing or correcting visual defects or abnormal conditions of the human eye or its adnexa; or the prescribing and application of lenses, devices containing lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision training, pharmaceutical agents, and prosthetic devices to correct, relieve, or treat defects or abnormal conditions of the human eye or its adnexa.
definition_quote.quote: Any one or any combination of the following practices shall constitute the practice of optometry

value: examination of the human eye (other than surgery)
employment of instruments, devices, pharmaceutical agents and procedures (other than surgery)
prescribing and application of lenses, contact lenses, prisms, orthoptics, vision training, pharmaceutical agents, and prosthetic devices
methods_authorized.quote: The examination of the human eye by any method, other than surgery...The employment of instruments, devices, pharmaceutical agents and procedures, other than surgery...The prescribing and application of lenses, devices containing lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision training, pharmaceutical agents, and prosthetic devices

drug_authority.value: Optometrists may prescribe and use pharmaceutical agents upon Board certification of educational qualification; licensed druggists may fill such prescriptions; dispensing optometrists may dispense legend or prescription drugs (not controlled substances) to their own patients upon registration with both the Board and NC Board of Pharmacy.
drug_authority.quote: No optometrist presently licensed in this State shall prescribe and use pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry unless and until he (i) has submitted to the Board evidence of satisfactory completion of all educational requirements established by the Board to prescribe and use pharmaceutical agents in the practice of optometry and (ii) has been certified by the Board as educationally qualified to prescribe and use pharmaceutical agents

surgery_prohibited.quote: The examination of the human eye by any method, other than surgery, to diagnose, to treat, or to refer for consultation or treatment any abnormal condition of the human eye and its adnexa

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: The prescribing and application of lenses, devices containing lenses, prisms, contact lenses, orthoptics, vision training, pharmaceutical agents, and prosthetic devices to correct, relieve, or treat defects or abnormal conditions of the human eye or its adnexa

controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: A registered dispensing optometrist shall not compound medications or dispense controlled substances

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: The employment of instruments, devices, pharmaceutical agents and procedures, other than surgery, intended for the purposes of investigating, examining, treating, diagnosing or correcting visual defects or abnormal conditions of the human eye or its adnexa

specialty_certification_types.quote: has been certified by the Board as educationally qualified to prescribe and use pharmaceutical agents

delegation_to_unlicensed_assistants_auth.quote: Any act or acts performed by an optometric assistant or technician to an optometrist licensed to practice in this State when said act or acts are authorized and permitted by and performed in accordance with rules and regulations promulgated by the Board

contact_lens_prescription_expiration_yea.quote: The prescriber shall state the expiration date on the face of every prescription, and the expiration date shall be no earlier than 365 days after the examination date

spectacle_prescription_release_required.quote: All persons licensed or registered under this Chapter shall upon request give each patient having received an eye examination a copy of the patient's spectacle prescription, consistent with Federal Trade Commission rules and guidelines

patient_record_retention_years.quote: Prescriptions filled pursuant to this section shall be kept on file by the prescriber and the person filling the prescription for at least 24 months after the prescription is filled

limited_teaching_license_available.quote: The teaching of optometry, in optometry schools or colleges operated and conducted in this State and approved by the North Carolina State Board of Examiners in Optometry, by any person or persons licensed to practice optometry anywhere in the United States or in any country, territory or other recognized jurisdiction
